entities.summary: Helen Folasade Adu, known professionally as Sade, is a Nigerian-born British singer and songwriter who is the lead vocalist of her band, Sade. One of the most successful British female artists in history, she is often recognised as an influence on contemporary music. Her success in the music industry was recognised with the honour Officer of the Order of the British Empire in the 2002 New Year Honours, and she was made Commander in the 2017 Birthday Honours.
